# GTM brain: Northbeam (demo client)
We are Northbeam. We sell Northbeam Signals, a signal-based outbound platform, and Pipeline Sprint, a done-for-you outbound program, to revenue leaders at B2B software companies with 50 to 500 employees.

Before any GTM task:
1. Read icp.md, offers.md and rules.md.
2. Check past-campaigns/ for what worked with this audience.
3. Use the files in products/ for every product fact.

Rules for every agent:
- Never invent a fact, a number, a name or a quote. Write "not found".
- Never use a claim that rules.md bans.
- Keep every campaign in draft until a person approves it.
- After a campaign, write its results to past-campaigns/ (use the close-campaign skill).
- Change icp.md, offers.md, rules.md or products/ only through a proposal. The brain owner (Sam Rivera) approves it.

This is sample data. Every company and person in it is fictional.
